standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Chow Homology, the lemma expressing the self intersection of the diagonal through the Gysin map, and the lemma identifying the Gysin map with capping by the top Chern class of the normal sheaf

standard_prerequisites.name: The conormal sheaf of the diagonal is the sheaf of differentials

standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the normal sheaf of the diagonal with the tangent sheaf of the variety.

standard_prerequisites.name: The degree map and the Kunneth decomposition of the class of the diagonal
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, the classical version of the description of degrees of cycles through the degree map, the lemmas on the pushforward of the unit and on pushforwards, and the classical version of the description of the class of the diagonal
standard_prerequisites.use: Computes the same intersection product through the cohomological degree map and the Kunneth components of the diagonal class.

core_obligations: The Chern class computation (proof lines 1805-1819): the self intersection of the diagonal is the pushforward along the diagonal of the Gysin pullback of the diagonal along itself; the pushforward preserves degrees of zero cycles, so it suffices to compute the degree of that pullback, which is capping with the top Chern class of the normal sheaf of the diagonal; since the conormal sheaf of the diagonal is the sheaf of differentials, the normal sheaf is the tangent sheaf.

The cohomological computation (proof lines 1821-1849): rewriting the degree of the intersection product through the degree map and using the projection formula together with the pushforward of the unit reduces the computation to the pairing on the variety of the pullback along the diagonal of the class of the diagonal; writing that class in its Kunneth decomposition and using that pullback along the diagonal is given by cup product turns the pairing into an alternating sum of the Betti numbers, which is the stated Euler characteristic.
proof_roadmap: Compute the self intersection of the diagonal by capping with the top Chern class of the tangent sheaf.
Rewrite the same intersection product through the degree map and the projection formula.
Identify it with the alternating sum of the Betti numbers through the Kunneth decomposition.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a classical Weil cohomology theory and a smooth projective variety the alternating sum of the Betti numbers equals the degree of the self intersection of the diagonal and equals the degree of the top Chern class of the tangent sheaf capped with the fundamental class (statement lines 1801-1808). The proof (proof lines 1809-1849) computes the self intersection through the Gysin map and the conormal sheaf of the diagonal, and through the degree map and the Kunneth decomposition of the diagonal class. H3: two independent computations of the same invariant, written out in full.
